````css
.appearance-popup > header small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
.appearance-popup > header button {
  width: var(--ui-control-md); height: var(--ui-control-md); padding: 0;
  display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  background: transparent; color: var(--ui-text-secondary);
}
.appearance-popup > header button:hover { background: var(--ui-bg-hover); color: var(--ui-text-primary); }
.appearance-popup-body { min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: var(--ui-space-3); }
.appearance-popup > footer { justify-content: flex-end; border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border); background: var(--ui-bg-subtle); }
.appearance-popup > footer button {
  min-height: var(--ui-control-lg); padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  background: var(--ui-bg-surface); color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium);
}
.appearance-popup > footer .primary { border-color: var(--ui-accent); background: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-text-on-accent); }

.style-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--ui-space-2); }
.style-grid label {
  min-height: 34px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ui-space-2);
  padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  color: var(--ui-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--ui-text-xs);
}
.setting-row {
  min-height: 32px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 112px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ui-space-3);
  margin-top: var(--ui-space-2);
}
.setting-row > label { margin: 0; }
.setting-row:has(#indicatorTf) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 6px; }
.setting-row:has(#indicatorTf) #indicatorTf { min-width: 0; min-height: 36px; }
.range-label { display: block; margin-top: var(--ui-space-2); }
.range-label > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--ui-space-2);
  color: var(--ui-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--ui-text-xs);
}
.range-label b { color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.range-label input[type="range"] { width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin-top: 3px; accent-color: var(--ui-accent); }

/* Info panel */
.indicator-info { padding: 12px; }
.info-last-calculation {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px var(--ui-space-3);
  align-items: center; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 7%, var(--ui-bg-surface)), var(--ui-bg-surface));
}
.info-last-calculation span { color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); }
.info-last-calculation strong { color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-lg); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }
.info-last-calculation small { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.indicator-activity { margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); background: var(--ui-bg-surface); }
.indicator-activity h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.indicator-activity ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.indicator-activity li {
  min-height: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 58px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 6px 5px 9px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ui-border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle);
}
.indicator-activity li time { color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.indicator-activity li b { font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }
.indicator-activity li span { min-width: 0; color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="info"] { border-left-color: var(--ui-accent); }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="data"] { border-left-color: #0891b2; }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="step"] { border-left-color: #4f46e5; }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="success"] { border-left-color: var(--ui-positive); }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="warning"] { border-left-color: var(--ui-warning); }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="error"] { border-left-color: var(--ui-danger); }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="success"] b { color: var(--ui-positive); }
.indicator-activity li[data-level="error"] b { color: var(--ui-danger); }
.indicator-activity .activity-empty { display: block; padding: 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--ui-border); text-align: center; }
.info-analysis-details { margin-top: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); background: var(--ui-bg-surface); overflow: hidden; }
.info-analysis-details > summary { padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); cursor: pointer; background: var(--ui-bg-subtle); }
.info-analysis-details > summary b { float: right; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); }
.info-empty {
  padding: var(--ui-space-8) var(--ui-space-4);
  border: 1px dashed var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-md);
  color: var(--ui-text-muted);
  text-align: center;
  line-height: var(--ui-leading-normal);
}
.info-analysis-details > :not(summary) { margin-left: 12px; margin-right: 12px; }
.info-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--ui-space-2);
  margin-bottom: var(--ui-space-3);
}
.info-metrics > div {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--ui-space-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  background: var(--ui-bg-subtle);
}
.info-metrics span,
.info-metrics strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-metrics span { color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.info-metrics strong { margin-top: 3px; font-size: var(--ui-text-md); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.info-timing { margin: 0 0 var(--ui-space-3); padding: var(--ui-space-3); border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); background: var(--ui-bg-subtle); }
.info-timing > header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--ui-space-2); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }
.info-timing > header strong { color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-md); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.info-timing > p { margin: 4px 0 var(--ui-space-2); color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.info-timing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px var(--ui-space-2); }
.info-timing-grid > div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--ui-space-2); min-width: 0; padding: 5px var(--ui-space-2); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-xs); background: var(--ui-bg-subtle); }
.info-timing-grid span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-timing-grid strong { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.info-timing .bottleneck { color: var(--ui-danger); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }
.info-stage-summary > ol { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: var(--ui-space-2) 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.info-stage-summary > ol li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 34px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-xs); background: var(--ui-bg-surface); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.info-stage-summary > ol i { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; }
.info-stage-summary > ol span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-stage-summary > ol small { padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ui-bg-active); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: 10px; }
.info-stage-summary > ol b { font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-progress-trace ol { max-height: 220px; margin: var(--ui-space-2) 0 0; padding: 0; overflow: auto; list-style: none; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.info-progress-trace li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--ui-space-2); padding: 6px var(--ui-space-2); border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.info-progress-trace li:first-child { border-top: 0; }
.info-progress-trace li[data-status="failed"] { color: var(--ui-danger); }
.info-progress-trace li[data-status="completed"], .info-progress-trace li[data-status="finished"] { color: var(--ui-positive); }
.info-progress-trace time, .info-progress-trace b { font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-progress-trace span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.info-meta {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 5px var(--ui-space-2);
  margin-bottom: var(--ui-space-3);
  padding: var(--ui-space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  font-size: var(--ui-text-xs);
}
.info-meta span { color: var(--ui-text-muted); }
.info-meta b { overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); }
.info-direction { margin-top: var(--ui-space-2); border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); overflow: hidden; }
.info-direction > header {
  min-height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ui-space-2);
  padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3);
  background: var(--ui-bg-subtle);
}
.info-direction > header i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
.info-direction.bullish > header i { background: var(--ui-positive); }
.info-direction.bearish > header i { background: var(--ui-negative); }
.info-direction > header strong { font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }
.info-direction > header span { margin-left: auto; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); text-align: right; }
.info-direction details { border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
.info-direction summary { padding: 10px var(--ui-space-3); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
.info-direction summary b { float: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.info-direction ol { max-height: 220px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3) var(--ui-space-2); list-style: none; }
.info-direction li { padding: var(--ui-space-2) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
.info-direction li b,
.info-direction li span { display: block; }
.info-direction li b { font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); }
.info-direction li span { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); line-height: var(--ui-leading-normal); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

/* Footer, templates and progress */
.indicator-panel > footer {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ui-space-2);
  padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  background: var(--ui-bg-subtle);
}
.indicator-panel > footer button,
.template-wrap > button {
  min-height: var(--ui-control-lg);
  padding: 0 var(--ui-space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm);
  background: var(--ui-bg-surface);
  color: var(--ui-text-primary);
  font-size: var(--ui-text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium);
}
.indicator-panel > footer button:hover,
.template-wrap > button:hover { background: var(--ui-bg-hover); }
.indicator-panel > footer .primary { border-color: var(--ui-accent); background: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-text-on-accent); }
.indicator-panel > footer .primary:hover { background: var(--ui-accent-hover); }
#indicatorStatus { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
#indicatorStatus i { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ui-text-disabled); }
#indicatorStatus span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#indicatorStatus.success i { background: var(--ui-positive); }
#indicatorStatus.error i { background: var(--ui-danger); }
#indicatorStatus.loading i { background: var(--ui-accent); animation: ui-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ui-pulse { 50% { opacity: .35; } }
.template-wrap { position: relative; }
.template-menu {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 42px;
  min-width: 180px;
  padding: var(--ui-space-1);
}
.template-menu button,
.template-menu small {
  width: 100%; min-height: var(--ui-control-md); display: block; padding: 6px 9px;
  border: 0; border-radius: var(--ui-radius-xs); background: transparent;
  color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); text-align: left;
}
.template-menu button:hover { background: var(--ui-bg-hover); }

.indicator-loading {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 1200;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100dvw;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: max(var(--ui-space-6), env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(var(--ui-space-6), env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(var(--ui-space-6), env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(var(--ui-space-6), env(safe-area-inset-left));
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .52);
  /* Avoid a full-viewport blur while timers update: it is costly on long stage lists. */
  backdrop-filter: none;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
.calculation-card {
  width: min(640px, 100%);
  height: min(720px, calc(100dvh - (var(--ui-space-6) * 2)));
  max-height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 35%, var(--ui-border));
  border-radius: calc(var(--ui-radius-md) + 2px);
  background: var(--ui-bg-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 28px 92px rgba(15, 23, 42, .32);
  contain: layout paint;
}
.progress-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--ui-space-3); padding: 18px 20px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
.progress-header > div { display: grid; gap: 3px; }
.calculation-kicker { color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.progress-header strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.progress-header > span { min-width: 48px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: var(--ui-radius-xs); background: var(--ui-accent-soft); color: var(--ui-accent); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-sm); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.calculation-overview { padding: 12px 20px 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 3%, var(--ui-bg-surface)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
.calculation-card p { margin: 0 0 var(--ui-space-3); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
.calculation-track { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--ui-radius-full); background: var(--ui-bg-active); }
.calculation-track i { width: 0; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--ui-accent); transition: width var(--ui-duration-base) linear; }
.calculation-summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--ui-space-3); margin: 9px 0 0; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#calculationElapsed { color: var(--ui-text-primary); font-size: var(--ui-text-sm); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.calculation-scroll-region { min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-gutter: stable; padding: 14px 20px 18px; }
.calculation-scroll-region:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-focus); outline-offset: -2px; }
.calculation-stage-wrap > header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: var(--ui-space-3); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
.calculation-stage-wrap > header > div { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.calculation-stage-wrap > header small { color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-normal); }
.calculation-stage-wrap > header > span { color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.calculation-stage-wrap > ol { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 7px; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.calculation-stage-wrap > ol li { min-height: 42px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 0; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-sm); background: var(--ui-bg-subtle); color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; }
.calculation-stage-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.calculation-stage-copy b { overflow: hidden; color: inherit; font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.calculation-stage-copy small { flex: none; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ui-bg-active); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.calculation-stage-wrap > ol li time { margin-left: auto; color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.calculation-card li i { width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-family: var(--ui-font-mono); font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.calculation-card li.active { color: var(--ui-accent); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-medium); }
.calculation-card li.active { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 24%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-accent) 7%, var(--ui-bg-surface)); }
.calculation-card li.active i { border-color: var(--ui-accent); background: var(--ui-accent); color: #fff; }
.calculation-card li.done { color: var(--ui-positive); }
.calculation-card li.done i { border-color: var(--ui-positive); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-positive) 12%, var(--ui-bg-surface)); }
.calculation-card li.skipped { color: var(--ui-text-disabled); }
.calculation-card li.skipped i { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--ui-text-disabled); }
.calculation-card li.failed { color: var(--ui-danger); }
.calculation-card li.failed i { border-color: var(--ui-danger); background: var(--ui-danger); }
.calculation-card li.bottleneck { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-danger) 30%, var(--ui-border)); }
.calculation-card li.bottleneck time { color: var(--ui-danger); font-weight: var(--ui-weight-semibold); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .calculation-track i,
  .calculation-stage-wrap > ol li { transition: none; }
}

.qg-color-picker {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 1000;
  width: 244px;
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: var(--ui-radius-md);
  background: var(--ui-bg-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-popover);
}
.qg-palette { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 16px); gap: 5px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }
.qg-palette button { position: relative; width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--swatch); }
.qg-palette button:hover { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }
.qg-palette button.selected::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 3px 5px; border: solid #fff; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1px #111827); }
.qg-custom-color { min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); color: var(--ui-text-secondary); font-size: var(--ui-text-xs); }
.qg-custom-color input { width: 28px; height: 24px; }
.qg-opacity-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 46px; gap: 6px; align-items: center; padding-top: 9px; color: var(--ui-text-muted); font-size: var(--ui-text-2xs); }
.qg-opacity-row span { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.qg-opacity-row input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; accent-color: var(--ui-accent); background-image: linear-gradient(45deg,#e5e7eb 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(-45deg,#e5e7eb 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 75%,#e5e7eb 75%),linear-gradient(-45deg,transparent 75%,#e5e7eb 75%); background-size: 8px 8px; }

/* Keep the full slider travel while making only its visual rail and thumb compact. */
.range-label input[type="range"],
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"],
.opacity-control input[type="range"] {
  appearance: none;
  height: 5px;
  background: transparent;
}
.range-label input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
.opacity-control input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--ui-accent) 0 var(--range-progress, 0%), var(--ui-border-strong) var(--range-progress, 0%) 100%);
}
.range-label input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.opacity-control input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  margin-top: -4px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ui-accent);
}
.range-label input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track,
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track,
.opacity-control input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ui-border-strong); }
.range-label input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress,
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress,
.opacity-control input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress { height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ui-accent); }
.range-label input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb,
.qg-opacity-row input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb,
.opacity-control input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ui-accent); }
.qg-opacity-row b { padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border); border-radius: var(--ui-radius-xs); color: var(--ui-text-primary); text-align: center; }
.qg-opacity-row.is-disabled { opacity: .48; }

.panel-resize-handle {
  position: absolute; z-index: 6; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -4px; width: 8px; cursor: col-resize; touch-action: none;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
#indicatorModal.is-pinned > .panel-resize-handle { left: 0; }
.panel-resize-handle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 3px; width: 1px; background: transparent; }
.panel-resize-handle:hover::after,
.panel-resize-handle:focus-visible::after { background: var(--ui-accent); }

@container (max-width: 360px) {
  .indicator-heading small { display: none; }
  .indicator-header { padding-inline: var(--ui-space-3); }
  .indicator-tabs { gap: var(--ui-space-3); padding-inline: var(--ui-space-3); }
  .tv-section { padding: var(--ui-space-3); }

  .setting-grid.three,

  .time-grid,
  .style-grid,
  .info-metrics,
  .info-timing-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .info-stage-summary > ol li { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
  .info-stage-summary > ol li small { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; }

}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
````

````javascript
        const appearance = orderObject?.customized ? orderObject : null;

        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(appearance?.fill ?? settings.orderFill, appearance?.opacity ?? settings.orderOpacity / 100);
        ctx.strokeStyle = appearance?.color ?? settings.orderColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = appearance?.width ?? settings.orderWidth;
        ctx.setLineDash(dash(appearance?.lineStyle ?? settings.orderLineStyle));
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.rect(left, top, Math.max(1, right - left), Math.max(1, bottom - top));
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (!settings.stopAllVisible || object?.hidden || x == null || y == null) continue;
      const radius = settings.stopAllRadius ?? INDICATOR_MARKER_DEFAULTS.stopAllRadius,
        shifted = offsetIndicatorPoint(object, x, y);
      state.indicator.hitBoxes.push({ objectId, shape: "point", x: shifted.x, y: shifted.y, radius: radius + 2 });
      const appearance = object?.customized ? object : null;
      const color = appearance?.color ?? settings.stopAllBorder;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(settings.stopAllFill, settings.stopAllOpacity / 100);
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.lineWidth = appearance?.width ?? settings.stopAllWidth;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(shifted.x, shifted.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      const labelSize = appearance?.size ?? settings.stopAllSize ?? INDICATOR_MARKER_DEFAULTS.stopAllSize;
      const labelY = shifted.y + (bullish ? 1 : -1) * (radius + settings.stopAllGap);
      ctx.font = `${object?.weight || 600} ${labelSize}px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = bullish ? "top" : "bottom";
      ctx.fillText(object?.text ?? String(zone.number), shifted.x, labelY);
      drawTrueFalseLabel(ctx, zone.trueFalse, secondaryVerdict.visible, labelSize,
        shifted.x, labelY + (bullish ? labelSize : -labelSize), bullish,
        TRUE_FALSE_STOPALL_PRIMARY_WEIGHT, zone.trueFalseRepeated === true, 0, secondaryVerdict);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (settings.orderStopVisible) {
      const seen = new Set();
      for (const zone of [...(group.sZones || []), ...(group.eZones || []), ...(group.stopAlls || [])]) {
        if (zone.calculationValid === false) continue;
        if (zone.orderStopSourceIndex == null || zone.orderStopLevel == null) continue;
        const key = [zone.orderDirection, zone.orderFirstIndex, zone.orderStopSourceIndex].join(":");
        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        const stopObject = indicatorObject(`indicator:${direction}:stop:${key}`);
        if (stopObject?.hidden) continue;
        const stopIndex = Number(zone.orderStopSourceIndex),
          endIndex = Math.min(
            Number.isFinite(+zone.decisionIndex) ? +zone.decisionIndex : stopIndex + settings.orderStopCap,
            stopIndex + settings.orderStopCap,
          );
        const
          startTime = zone.orderStopSourceTime,
          endTime = Number(startTime) +
            Math.max(1, endIndex - stopIndex) *
              timeframe,
          visibleEndTime = Number.isFinite(+zone.decisionTime)
            ? Math.min(+zone.decisionTime, endTime)
            : endTime;
        const
          x1 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(startTime),
          x2 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(visibleEndTime),
          y = priceToY(+zone.orderStopLevel);
        if ([x1, x2, y].some((value) => value == null)) continue;
        const shifted = offsetIndicatorRect(stopObject, x1, y, x2, y);
        state.indicator.hitBoxes.push({ objectId: `indicator:${direction}:stop:${key}`, shape: "line", x1: shifted.x1, y1: shifted.y1, x2: shifted.x2, y2: shifted.y2 });
        const appearance = stopObject?.customized ? stopObject : null;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = appearance?.color ?? settings.orderStopColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = appearance?.width ?? settings.orderStopWidth;
        ctx.lineCap = (appearance?.lineStyle ?? settings.orderStopLineStyle) === "dot" ? "round" : "butt";
        ctx.setLineDash(dash(appearance?.lineStyle ?? (settings.orderStopLineStyle || "dot")));
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(shifted.x1, shifted.y1);
        ctx.lineTo(shifted.x2, shifted.y2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
    const representedOrderKeys = new Set(
      [...(group.sZones || []), ...(group.eZones || []), ...(group.stopAlls || [])]
        .filter((item) => item.calculationValid !== false && item.orderFirstIndex != null && item.orderBreakIndex != null)
        .map((item) => `${item.orderFirstIndex}:${item.orderBreakIndex}`),
    );
    for (const [auditIndex, order] of (group.orderAudit || []).entries()) {
      const key = `${order.firstIndex}:${order.breakIndex}`;
      if (representedOrderKeys.has(key)) continue;
      const objectId = `indicator:${direction}:audit-order:${order.firstIndex}:${order.breakIndex}`,
        object = indicatorObject(objectId),
        orderBullish = order.direction === "bullish",
        startTime = orderBullish ? order.boxTopSourceTime : order.boxBottomSourceTime,
        x1 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(startTime),
        x2 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(order.breakTime),
        yTop = priceToY(+order.boxTop),
        yBottom = priceToY(+order.boxBottom);
      if (!settings.orderVisible || object?.hidden || [x1, x2, yTop, yBottom].some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value))) continue;
      const shifted = offsetIndicatorRect(object, x1, yTop, x2, yBottom),
        left = Math.min(shifted.x1, shifted.x2),
        right = Math.max(shifted.x1, shifted.x2),
        top = Math.min(shifted.y1, shifted.y2),
        bottom = Math.max(shifted.y1, shifted.y2);
      state.indicator.hitBoxes.push({ objectId, shape: "rect", left, right, top, bottom });
      const appearance = object?.customized ? object : null;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(appearance?.fill ?? settings.orderFill, appearance?.opacity ?? settings.orderOpacity / 100);
      ctx.strokeStyle = appearance?.color ?? settings.orderColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = appearance?.width ?? settings.orderWidth;
      ctx.setLineDash(dash(appearance?.lineStyle ?? settings.orderLineStyle));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(left, top, Math.max(1, right - left), Math.max(1, bottom - top));
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (settings.eStopVisible) {
      for (const [zoneIndex, zone] of (group.eZones || []).entries()) {
        const parentStopIndex = Number(zone.parentStopIndex),
          parentSourceIndex = Number(zone.parentSourceIndex);
        if (
          String(zone.parentType).toUpperCase() !== "E" ||
          !Number.isFinite(parentStopIndex) ||
          !Number.isFinite(parentSourceIndex) ||
          parentStopIndex - parentSourceIndex <= 350
        )
          continue;
        const objectId = `indicator:${direction}:e-stop:${zoneIndex + objectOffsets.eZones}`,
          stopObject = indicatorObject(objectId);
        if (stopObject?.hidden) continue;
        const x1 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(zone.parentSourceTime),
          x2 = indicatorTimeToCoordinate(zone.parentStopTime),
          y = priceToY(+zone.parentPrice);
        if ([x1, x2, y].some((value) => value == null)) continue;
        const shifted = offsetIndicatorRect(stopObject, x1, y, x2, y);
        state.indicator.hitBoxes.push({
          objectId,
          shape: "line",
          x1: shifted.x1,
          y1: shifted.y1,
          x2: shifted.x2,
          y2: shifted.y2,
        });
        const appearance = stopObject?.customized ? stopObject : null;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = appearance?.color ?? settings.eStopColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = appearance?.width ?? settings.eStopWidth;
        ctx.lineCap = (appearance?.lineStyle ?? settings.eStopLineStyle) === "dot" ? "round" : "butt";
        ctx.setLineDash(dash(appearance?.lineStyle ?? (settings.eStopLineStyle || "dot")));
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(shifted.x1, shifted.y1);
        ctx.lineTo(shifted.x2, shifted.y2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
    drawPrimaryStructures(ctx, group, {
      direction, settings, timeframe,
      timeToX: indicatorTimeToCoordinate,
      priceToY,
      objectFor: indicatorObject,
      offsetPoint: offsetIndicatorPoint,
      offsetRect: offsetIndicatorRect,
      onHit: (hit) => state.indicator.hitBoxes.push(hit),
    });
    if (Number.isFinite(historicalEndX)) {
      state.indicator.hitBoxes.push(...clipHistoricalHitBoxes(
        state.indicator.hitBoxes.splice(firstHitIndex), historicalEndX));
    }
    ctx.restore();
    for (const transition of group.trendTransitions || []) trendTransitions.push(transition);
  }
  drawTrendTransitions(ctx, { trendTransitions }, {
    timeToX: indicatorTimeToCoordinate,
    priceToY,
    width: plotWidth,
    height: plotHeight,
    settings,
  });
}
````

````javascript
// Presentation of finalized Engine PH, PL and matching-behavior-leg results.
// Price crossings, structure validity and numbering remain Engine-owned.
import { formatTehranMetadataTime } from "../features/raw-file-contract.js";
import { drawTrueFalseLabel, trueFalseAppearance, TRUE_FALSE_STOPALL_PRIMARY_WEIGHT } from "./true-false-label.js";

export const PRIMARY_VISUAL_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
  phVisible: true,
  phLabelVisible: true,
  plVisible: true,
  plLabelVisible: true,
  mblVisible: true,
  mblLabelVisible: true,
  primaryArrowColor: "#056656",
  primaryArrowSize: 12,
  primaryCircleColor: "#ec407a",
  primaryCircleRadius: 4,
  primaryCircleOpacity: 100,
  primaryLabelSize: 12,
  primaryGap: 12,
  primaryLabelGap: 10,
  mblColor: "#b22833",
  mblWidth: 2,
  mblSize: 9,
  mblLineStyle: "dot",
});

const FONT = 'Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
const MBL_UNBROKEN_CANDLES = 400;
export const TREND_VISUAL_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
  trendLineVisible: true,
  trendBullColor: "#00a886",
  trendBearColor: "#f23645",
  trendLineWidth: 1,
  trendLineStyle: "dash",
  trendIconSize: 28,
  trendIconGap: 100,
  trendLabelSize: 10,
});

export function clipHistoricalHitBoxes(hits, right) {
  if (right < 0) return [];
  return hits.flatMap(hit => {
    const clipped = { ...hit, clipRight: right };
    if (hit.shape === "rect") {
      if (hit.left >= right) return [];
      clipped.right = Math.min(hit.right, right);
    } else if (hit.shape === "point") {
      if (hit.x - (hit.radius || 12) >= right) return [];
    } else if (hit.shape === "line") {
      if (Math.min(hit.x1, hit.x2) >= right) return [];
      if (Math.max(hit.x1, hit.x2) > right) {
        const y = hit.y1 + (right - hit.x1) * (hit.y2 - hit.y1) / (hit.x2 - hit.x1);
        const end = hit.x1 > right ? "1" : "2";
        clipped[`x${end}`] = right;
        clipped[`y${end}`] = y;
      }
    }
    return [clipped];
  });
}

export function trendTransitionLayout(transition, { timeToX, priceToY, height, settings = {} }) {
  const lineX = timeToX(transition.sourceTime);
  const bullish = transition.direction !== "bearish";
  const targetPrice = bullish ? transition.iconCandleHigh : transition.iconCandleLow;
  let icon = null;
  if (transition.iconCandleTime != null && targetPrice != null) {
    const centerX = timeToX(transition.iconCandleTime);
    const priceY = priceToY(Number(targetPrice));
    if (Number.isFinite(centerX) && Number.isFinite(priceY)) {
      const size = settings.trendIconSize ?? TREND_VISUAL_DEFAULTS.trendIconSize;
      const gap = settings.trendIconGap ?? TREND_VISUAL_DEFAULTS.trendIconGap;
      const top = bullish ? priceY - gap - size : priceY + gap;
      icon = { left: centerX - size / 2, top, right: centerX + size / 2, bottom: top + size, size };
    }
  }
  return { lineX, lineBottom: height, icon };
}

export function drawTrendTransitions(ctx, group, { timeToX, priceToY, width = Infinity, height, settings = {} }) {
  const transitions = group.trendTransitions;
  if (!transitions?.length || settings.trendLineVisible === false) return;
  const style = settingsWithDefaults(settings, TREND_VISUAL_DEFAULTS);
  const labels = [];
  for (const transition of transitions) {
    const bullish = transition.direction !== "bearish";
    const color = bullish ? style.trendBullColor : style.trendBearColor;
    const marker = trendTransitionLayout(transition, { timeToX, priceToY, height, settings });
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = style.trendLineWidth;
    ctx.lineCap = style.trendLineStyle === "dot" ? "round" : "butt";
    ctx.setLineDash(style.trendLineStyle === "dot" ? [0, style.trendLineWidth * 3]
      : style.trendLineStyle === "dash" ? [6, 5] : []);
    if (Number.isFinite(marker.lineX) && marker.lineX >= 0 && marker.lineX <= width) {
      const label = trendTimestampLayout(ctx, transition.sourceTime, marker.lineX, width, height, style.trendLabelSize, labels);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(marker.lineX, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(marker.lineX, label?.top ?? marker.lineBottom);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (label) labels.push({ ...label, color });
    }
    if (marker.icon) {
      const { left, top, size } = marker.icon;
      ctx.translate(left, top + (bullish ? 0 : size));
      ctx.scale(size / 20, (bullish ? 1 : -1) * size / 20);
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(1.2, 18.8);
      ctx.lineTo(6.1, 12.2);
      ctx.lineTo(9.3, 15.4);
      ctx.lineTo(13.7, 8.4);
      ctx.lineTo(16, 10.5);
      ctx.lineTo(18.8, 1.2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(13.2, 3);
      ctx.lineTo(18.8, 1.2);
      ctx.lineTo(18.1, 7);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  for (const label of labels) drawTrendTimestamp(ctx, label);
}

function trendTimestampLayout(ctx, sourceTime, lineX, width, height, size, labels) {
  const epoch = Number(sourceTime);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(epoch) || epoch < 1 || width < 32 || height < size + 12) return null;
  const text = formatTehranMetadataTime(epoch).slice(0, 19);
  const font = `600 ${size}px ${FONT}`;
  const margin = 2;
  const padding = 4;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = font;
  const badgeWidth = Math.min(ctx.measureText(text).width + padding * 2, width - margin * 2);
  ctx.restore();
  const badgeHeight = size + padding * 2;
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(lineX - badgeWidth / 2, margin), width - margin - badgeWidth);
  let top = height - margin - badgeHeight;
  const spacing = 3;
  while (labels.some(label => label.top === top && left < label.left + label.width + spacing
    && label.left < left + badgeWidth + spacing)) top -= badgeHeight + spacing;
  if (top < margin) return null;
  return { text, font, left, top, width: badgeWidth, height: badgeHeight, padding };
}

function drawTrendTimestamp(ctx, label) {
  const { text, font, left, top, width, height, padding, color } = label;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.75;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.96)";
  ctx.fillRect(left, top, width, height);
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.strokeRect(left, top, width, height);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111827";
  ctx.font = font;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(text, left + width / 2, top + height / 2, width - padding * 2);
  ctx.restore();
}

function settingsWithDefaults(settings = {}, defaults = PRIMARY_VISUAL_DEFAULTS) {
  const output = { ...defaults };
  for (const key of Object.keys(output)) {
    if (settings[key] != null) output[key] = settings[key];
  }
  return output;
}

export function primaryMarkerLayout(kind, direction, x, y, settings = {}) {
  const style = settingsWithDefaults(settings);
  const above = kind === "PH";
  const sign = above ? -1 : 1;
  const arrow = (kind === "PH") === (direction === "bearish");
  const radius = arrow ? style.primaryArrowSize / 2 : style.primaryCircleRadius;
  const centerY = y + sign * (style.primaryGap + radius);
  return {
    shape: arrow ? "chevrons" : "circle",
    pointsDown: above,
    x, y: centerY, radius,
    top: centerY - radius, bottom: centerY + radius,
    labelY: centerY + sign * (radius + style.primaryLabelGap),
    textBaseline: above ? "bottom" : "top",
    color: kind === "PH" ? style.primaryArrowColor : style.primaryCircleColor,
    opacity: arrow ? 1 : style.primaryCircleOpacity / 100,
    fontSize: style.primaryLabelSize,
  };
}

export function indicatorCalculationSegments(results) {
  const output = [];
  const fields = ["reactions", "blueLines", "aZones", "sZones", "eZones", "stopAlls"];
  for (const [direction, aggregate] of Object.entries(results.directions || {})) {
    const offsets = Object.fromEntries(fields.map(key => [key, 0]));
    for (const group of aggregate.calculationSegments || [aggregate]) {
      output.push({ direction, group, objectOffsets: { ...offsets } });
      for (const key of fields) offsets[key] += (group[key] || []).length;
    }
  }
  return output;
}

export function primaryObjectId(direction, kind, item) {
  const physical = item.id ?? `${item.sourceTime}:${item.sourceIndex ?? ""}:${item.decisionEventTime ?? ""}:${item.number ?? ""}`;
  return `indicator:${direction}:primary:${kind}:${physical}`;
}

export function primaryLabelLayout(marker, metrics) {
  const ascent = metrics.actualBoundingBoxAscent ?? marker.fontSize * 0.8;
  const descent = metrics.actualBoundingBoxDescent ?? marker.fontSize * 0.2;
  const baselineY = marker.textBaseline === "bottom"
    ? marker.labelY - descent : marker.labelY + ascent;
  return { baselineY, left: marker.x - metrics.width / 2, right: marker.x + metrics.width / 2,
    top: baselineY - ascent, bottom: baselineY + descent };
}

export function primaryVisualObjects(group, direction, settings = {}) {
  const style = settingsWithDefaults(settings);
  const output = [];
  for (const [kind, rows] of [["PH", group.primaryHighs], ["PL", group.primaryLows]]) {
    for (const item of rows || []) {
      if (item.calculationValid === false) continue;
      const marker = primaryMarkerLayout(kind, direction, 0, 0, settings);
      output.push({
        id: primaryObjectId(direction, kind, item),
        type: "indicator-label", primaryKind: kind,
        name: `${kind}-${item.number}`, text: `${kind}-${item.number}`,
        time: item.sourceTime, price: item.price,
        color: marker.color, fill: marker.color, size: marker.fontSize,
        opacity: marker.opacity, weight: 600,
      });
    }
  }
  for (const item of group.matchingBehaviorLegs || []) {
    if (item.calculationValid === false) continue;
    output.push({
      id: primaryObjectId(direction, "MBL", item),
      type: "indicator-stop", primaryKind: "MBL", name: "MBL", text: "MBL",
      time: item.sourceTime, price: item.price,
      color: style.mblColor, size: style.mblSize, width: style.mblWidth,
      lineStyle: style.mblLineStyle, opacity: 1,
    });
  }
  return output;
}

export function matchingLegEndTime(leg, latest, timeframe) {
  const cap = leg.capTime != null
    ? Number(leg.capTime)
    : Number(leg.sourceTime) + MBL_UNBROKEN_CANDLES * timeframe;
  if (leg.stopIndex == null) return cap;
  const end = leg.stopTime != null
    ? Number(leg.stopTime)
    : Number(leg.sourceTime) + (Number(leg.stopIndex) - Number(leg.sourceIndex)) * timeframe;
  return Math.min(end, cap);
}

function drawChevrons(ctx, marker) {
  const stroke = Math.max(1, marker.radius / 3);
  const left = marker.x - marker.radius + stroke / 2;
  const right = marker.x + marker.radius - stroke / 2;
  const top = marker.top + stroke / 2;
  const height = marker.radius * 2 - stroke;
  ctx.lineWidth = stroke;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (const offset of [0, height * 0.55]) {
    const edge = marker.pointsDown ? top + offset : marker.bottom - stroke / 2 - offset;
    const tip = edge + (marker.pointsDown ? 1 : -1) * height * 0.45;
    ctx.moveTo(left, edge);
    ctx.lineTo(marker.x, tip);
    ctx.lineTo(right, edge);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
}

export function drawPrimaryStructures(ctx, group, {
  direction, settings = {}, timeframe, timeToX, priceToY,
  objectFor = () => null,
  offsetPoint = (_object, x, y) => ({ x, y }),
  offsetRect = (_object, x1, y1, x2, y2) => ({ x1, y1, x2, y2 }),
  onHit = () => {},
}) {
  const style = settingsWithDefaults(settings);
  const verdict = trueFalseAppearance(settings, "primary");
  for (const [kind, rows, visible, labelVisible] of [
    ["PH", group.primaryHighs, settings.phGroupVisible ?? style.phVisible,
      settings.phGroupVisible ?? style.phLabelVisible],
    ["PL", group.primaryLows, settings.plGroupVisible ?? style.plVisible,
      settings.plGroupVisible ?? style.plLabelVisible],
  ]) {
    if (!visible && !labelVisible) continue;
    for (const item of rows || []) {
      if (item.calculationValid === false) continue;
      const objectId = primaryObjectId(direction, kind, item);
      const object = objectFor(objectId);
      if (object?.hidden) continue;
      const x = timeToX(item.sourceTime), y = priceToY(Number(item.price));
      if (x == null || y == null || !Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) continue;
      const shifted = offsetPoint(object, x, y);
      const marker = primaryMarkerLayout(kind, direction, shifted.x, shifted.y, settings);
      const appearance = object?.customized ? object : null;
      const color = appearance?.color ?? marker.color;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = appearance?.opacity ?? marker.opacity;
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      if (visible) {
        if (marker.shape === "circle") {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(marker.x, marker.y, marker.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else {
          drawChevrons(ctx, marker);
        }
        onHit({ objectId, shape: "point", x: marker.x, y: marker.y, radius: marker.radius + 2 });
      }
      if (labelVisible) {
        const size = appearance?.size ?? marker.fontSize;
        const text = object?.text ?? `${kind}-${item.number}`;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.font = `${object?.weight || 600} ${size}px ${FONT}`;
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
        const label = primaryLabelLayout({ ...marker, fontSize: size }, ctx.measureText(text));
        ctx.fillText(text, marker.x, label.baselineY);
        const below = marker.textBaseline === "top";
        drawTrueFalseLabel(ctx, item.trueFalse, verdict.visible, size,
          marker.x, below ? label.bottom : label.top, below, TRUE_FALSE_STOPALL_PRIMARY_WEIGHT, false, 2, verdict);
        onHit({ objectId, shape: "rect", left: label.left, right: label.right,
          top: label.top, bottom: label.bottom });
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  const mblVisible = settings.mblGroupVisible ?? style.mblVisible;
  const mblLabelVisible = settings.mblGroupVisible ?? style.mblLabelVisible;
  if (!mblVisible && !mblLabelVisible) return;
  const legs = (group.matchingBehaviorLegs || []).filter(item => item.calculationValid !== false);
  const latest = legs.reduce((chosen, item) => !chosen ||
    Number(item.triggerEventTime ?? item.triggerTime ?? item.sourceTime) >
      Number(chosen.triggerEventTime ?? chosen.triggerTime ?? chosen.sourceTime) ? item : chosen, null);
  for (const leg of legs) {
    const objectId = primaryObjectId(direction, "MBL", leg);
    const object = objectFor(objectId);
    if (object?.hidden) continue;
    const x1 = timeToX(leg.sourceTime), x2 = timeToX(matchingLegEndTime(leg, leg === latest, timeframe));
    const y = priceToY(Number(leg.price));
    if ([x1, x2, y].some(value => value == null || !Number.isFinite(value))) continue;
    const line = offsetRect(object, x1, y, x2, y);
    const appearance = object?.customized ? object : null;
    const color = appearance?.color ?? style.mblColor;
    const lineStyle = appearance?.lineStyle ?? style.mblLineStyle;
    const width = appearance?.width ?? style.mblWidth;
    const fontSize = appearance?.size ?? style.mblSize;
    const label = object?.text ?? "MBL";
    const middle = (line.x1 + line.x2) / 2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.lineCap = lineStyle === "dot" ? "round" : "butt";
    ctx.setLineDash(lineStyle === "dot" ? [0, width * 3] : lineStyle === "dash" ? [6, 4] : []);
    ctx.font = `500 ${fontSize}px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const gap = mblLabelVisible ? ctx.measureText(label).width / 2 + 6 : 0;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (!gap) {
      ctx.moveTo(line.x1, line.y1);
      ctx.lineTo(line.x2, line.y2);
    } else {
      if (middle - gap > line.x1) {
        ctx.moveTo(line.x1, line.y1);
        ctx.lineTo(middle - gap, line.y1);
      }
      if (middle + gap < line.x2) {
        ctx.moveTo(middle + gap, line.y2);
        ctx.lineTo(line.x2, line.y2);
      }
    }
    if (mblVisible) ctx.stroke();
    if (mblLabelVisible) {
      ctx.fillText(label, middle, line.y1);
      onHit({ objectId, shape: "rect", left: middle - gap, right: middle + gap,
        top: line.y1 - fontSize / 2, bottom: line.y1 + fontSize / 2 });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    if (mblVisible) onHit({ objectId, shape: "line", ...line });
  }
}
````

````javascript
const FONT = 'Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
const LABEL_COLORS = { T: "#047857", F: "#be123c", "N/A": "#b8b8b8" };
const LABEL_SETTINGS = { T: "TrueColor", F: "FalseColor", "N/A": "NaColor" };
export const TRUE_FALSE_LABEL_WEIGHT = 300;
export const TRUE_FALSE_STOPALL_PRIMARY_WEIGHT = 700;
export const TRUE_FALSE_VISUAL_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(
  ["foundation", "secondary", "primary"].flatMap(prefix => [
    [`${prefix}TfVisible`, true],
    [`${prefix}TfSize`, 0],
    ...Object.entries(LABEL_SETTINGS).map(([label, key]) => [`${prefix}Tf${key}`, LABEL_COLORS[label]]),
  ]),
));

export function trueFalseAppearance(settings, group) {
  const prefix = `${group}Tf`;
  return {
    visible: settings[`${prefix}Visible`] ?? settings.trueFalseVisible,
    size: settings[`${prefix}Size`],
    colors: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(LABEL_SETTINGS).map(([label, key]) => [
      label, settings[`${prefix}${key}`] ?? LABEL_COLORS[label],
    ])),
  };
}

export function drawTrueFalseLabel(ctx, verdict, visible, parentSize, x, edgeY, below,
  weight = TRUE_FALSE_LABEL_WEIGHT, repeated = false, verdictSizeOffset = 0, appearance = {}) {
  const label = verdict === null ? "N/A" : verdict;
  if (visible === false || !Object.hasOwn(LABEL_COLORS, label)) return;
  const customSize = Number(appearance.size);
  const useCustomSize = customSize > 0 && Number.isFinite(customSize);
  const autoSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(9, parentSize - 2));
  const size = useCustomSize ? customSize : autoSize;
  const labelSize = label !== "N/A" && !useCustomSize ? size + verdictSizeOffset : size;
  const labelWeight = label === "N/A" ? 300 : weight;
  const colors = appearance.colors ?? LABEL_COLORS;
  const direction = below ? 1 : -1;
  let y = edgeY + 3 * direction;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = below ? "top" : "bottom";
  const showRepeat = repeated && label !== "N/A";
  const starColor = appearance.repeatStarColor;
  if (showRepeat && !starColor) {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors["N/A"];
    ctx.font = `300 ${size}px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillText("N/A", x, y);
    y += (size + 2) * direction;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = colors[label];
  ctx.font = `${labelWeight} ${labelSize}px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillText(label, x, y);
  if (showRepeat && starColor) {
    ctx.fillStyle = starColor;
    ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    const starY = below ? edgeY - parentSize - 3 : y - labelSize - 2;
    ctx.fillText("*", x, starY);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
````

````javascript
const RAW_FILENAME_PATTERN = /^RAW ([A-Z0-9.-]+)_([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]*) (\d+[SMHD]) FROM (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}) TO (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.json$/;

const tehranParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
  timeZone: "Asia/Tehran", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
  hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23",
});

function partsAt(epochSeconds) {
  return tehranParts.formatToParts(new Date(Number(epochSeconds) * 1000))
    .reduce((result, part) => ((result[part.type] = part.value), result), {});
}

function safePart(value, label) {
  const result = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase().replace(/:/g, "_");
  if (!result || !/^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]*$/.test(result)) throw new Error(`The RAW ${label} is invalid.`);
  return result;
}

export function formatTehranFileTime(epochSeconds) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(epochSeconds)) || Number(epochSeconds) <= 0) throw new Error("The RAW candle time is invalid.");
  const parts = partsAt(epochSeconds);
  return `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day} ${parts.hour}-${parts.minute}-${parts.second}`;
}

export function formatTehranMetadataTime(epochSeconds) {
  return `${formatTehranFileTime(epochSeconds).replace(/ (\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/, " $1:$2:$3")} Asia/Tehran`;
}

export function parseTehranMetadataTime(value) {
  const match = String(value || "").trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2}) Asia\/Tehran$/);
  if (!match) return NaN;
  const desiredUtc = Date.UTC(+match[1], +match[2] - 1, +match[3], +match[4], +match[5], +match[6]);
  let candidate = Math.floor(desiredUtc / 1000);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    const parts = partsAt(candidate);
    const renderedUtc = Date.UTC(+parts.year, +parts.month - 1, +parts.day, +parts.hour, +parts.minute, +parts.second);
    candidate += Math.round((desiredUtc - renderedUtc) / 1000);
  }
  return formatTehranMetadataTime(candidate) === String(value).trim() ? candidate : NaN;
}

export function buildRawFilename({ broker, symbol, timeframe, firstTime, lastTime }) {
  const normalizedBroker = safePart(broker, "broker");
  const normalizedSymbol = safePart(symbol, "symbol");
  const normalizedTimeframe = String(timeframe || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^\d+[SMHD]$/.test(normalizedTimeframe)) throw new Error("The RAW timeframe is invalid.");
  return `RAW ${normalizedBroker}_${normalizedSymbol} ${normalizedTimeframe} FROM ${formatTehranFileTime(firstTime)} TO ${formatTehranFileTime(lastTime)}.json`;
}

export function parseRawFilename(filename) {
  const match = String(filename || "").match(RAW_FILENAME_PATTERN);
  if (!match || match[1] === "FARAZ") return null;
  return { broker: match[1], symbol: match[2], timeframe: match[3], fromTehran: match[4], toTehran: match[5] };
}
````
